name: markdown-review
description: Review Markdown, Word (.docx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) with inline commenting, AI agent tools, and Copilot integration

commands.title: Markdown Review: Open Word Document Preview

languageModelTools.name: docReview_list_comments
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all review comments on the active document (markdown or Word). Returns each comment's ID, text, status (resolved/unresolved), block type, surrounding context, reply count, and role. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comments are on, especially when multiple files are open. Without filePath, the tool uses the currently active editor tab which may not be the intended file.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx). If omitted, uses the currently active document.

languageModelTools.name: docReview_read_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a specific review comment by ID, including its full text, all replies, and the surrounding document context (5 lines before and after the anchored block). IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may look in the wrong file and return 'not found'.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to read (e.g., 'c1773348143590')

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_reply_to_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replies to an existing review comment. The reply is added with role 'agent'. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active in the editor.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to reply to

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_resolve_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Marks a review comment as resolved. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active in the editor.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to resolve

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_delete_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a review comment and removes its anchor from the document. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on. Without filePath, the tool may fail to find the comment if a different file is active.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_scroll_to_comment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scrolls the document review preview to show the block associated with a specific comment. Also reveals the source line in the editor. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file the comment is on.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to scroll to

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_capture_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Captures the rendered document review preview as a self-contained HTML file. Saves to .review-screenshot.html next to the document file. IMPORTANT: Always pass the filePath parameter when you know which file to capture.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the document file (markdown or docx).

languageModelTools.name: docReview_capture_slide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Captures a specific PowerPoint slide as a PNG image. Provide the 1-based slide number. Saves to .review-slideN.png next to the .pptx file. Use this to visually verify slide changes after editing XML. IMPORTANT: Always pass both slideNumber and filePath.

slideNumber.description: The 1-based slide number to capture (e.g. 1 for the first slide).

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute or workspace-relative path to the .pptx file.

languageModelTools.name: docReview_read_element_xml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the raw XML of a specific element (paragraph, heading, etc.) from a Word (.docx) document. Returns the element's plain text content, its raw XML for editing, and the path to the extracted document.xml file. Use this to inspect element structure before making changes. For substantial edits, you can edit the document.xml file directly at the returned path. WARNING: Do NOT modify commentRangeStart/commentRangeEnd elements — those are existing Word comments.

elementId.description: The element ID (paraId) to read, e.g. '77FE7CF5'. Get IDs from listReviewComments or readReviewComment.

languageModelTools.name: docReview_write_element_xml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replaces the raw XML of a specific element in a Word (.docx) document. Provide the complete replacement XML for the element (including the <w:p> tags and all attributes). The preview will refresh after the edit. Use saveDocument to write the changes back to a .docx file. WARNING: Do NOT remove or modify commentRangeStart/commentRangeEnd elements. For substantial multi-element edits, use readElementXml to get the document.xml path and edit the file directly instead.

newXml.description: The complete replacement XML for this element, including <w:p> tags and all namespace attributes.

languageModelTools.name: docReview_save_document
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Saves all pending edits back to a .docx file. Re-zips the modified XML into a valid Word document. If outputPath is not provided, saves as filename_reviewed.docx. All existing Word comments, images, styles, and formatting are preserved.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the source .docx file.

outputPath.description: Optional. Path for the output .docx file. Defaults to filename_reviewed.docx.

languageModelTools.name: docReview_list_elements
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all elements (paragraphs, headings, tables, images, formulas) in a Word (.docx) document as a compact text outline with element IDs. Use this to understand the document structure and content before making targeted edits. Each element shows its type, paraId, and a text preview. Much smaller than raw XML (~7K tokens vs ~68K).

scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:extension && npm run bundle:mcp
scripts.test:agent-plugin: npm run build:agent-plugin && npx tsc -p agent-plugin/tsconfig.json && node agent-plugin/test/test-server.js
